description: This file contains JavaScript code for handling AJAX interactions within the Views UI module of Drupal, including commands for highlighting elements, setting form actions, showing buttons, triggering previews, replacing page titles, and managing behaviors for live preview and AJAX links.

methods.name: viewsHighlight
methods.description: Highlights a DOM element specified by the response selector by adding a 'hilited' class after removing it from others.

methods.name: viewsSetForm
methods.description: Sets the form submit action in the views modal edit form, binding the clicked button to the form's clk property.

methods.name: viewsShowButtons
methods.description: Shows certain buttons in the views edit form and displays change messages if the state changed.

methods.name: viewsTriggerPreview
methods.description: Triggers the preview submit button if the live preview checkbox is checked.

methods.name: viewsReplaceTitle
methods.description: Replaces the page title and updates the <h1> element with the new title.

methods.name: tableDragChangedWarning
methods.description: Returns an empty array to suppress tabledrag warning messages.

methods.name: livePreview.attach
methods.description: Attaches a click event to trigger live preview when the checkbox is checked.

methods.name: syncPreviewDisplay.attach
methods.description: Attaches click events to tab links to sync the preview display with the selected tab.

methods.name: viewsAjax.attach
methods.description: Attaches AJAX behaviors to links and form buttons within the Views UI, enabling AJAX interactions for links, previews, and exposed widgets.
